chapter: The 1920s road: dance style and management
title: Why vaudeville quality was better than today's
summary: He says performers then had to be clever and versatile for less pay, while today anyone is hired and paid more.

blocks.x: But the quality of entertainment is different than it is today also, is that so?
Yeah. Yep, quality was different, mh-ha.
Can you tell me a little bit more about that?
Better -- what date are you talking about?
Well, this time now that you're talking about. The time that you're talking about now in particular. You say vaudeville in general, the quality of entertainment was a lot better than it is today.

They ain't got nothing to offer today. Don't talk about today. We're talking now about over 25 years ago. If you're talking about now over 25 years ago, you can't match that with today. Because today nothing is like it was then. 'Cause you had to have more to offer then than you have to today.

questions like that. You have more money today than you did then. Why's that? That's the same question. You have to have more money today than you did then. Your salary was cheaper. Today your salary is higher. But you do less for your salary today than you did then. Had to do more then for your money. Had to be clever then for your money. Today you don't have to be clever. Just whatever you are, you get paid for whatever they want to pay you for that today. Today is better for the actor that has no versatility more so than it was at that time because they just hire anybody today. Twenty-five years ago, you know, there's such a difference -- my goodness. Words fail me.
